lockedMove.proposition: Hilbert's Hotel subtraction cases yield no contradiction because standard Cantorian transfinite arithmetic lacks the assumed infinity-subtraction operation, while relative complements consistently represent each checkout case.

components.text: The checkout cases are consistent relative-complement operations, not contradictory instances of a single infinity-minus-infinity result.
